PYELONEPHRITIS.title: Pyelonephritis (kidney infection)

items: Pyelonephritis is an infection of the kidney, usually spreading up from the bladder.
It is more serious than a bladder infection and needs prompt treatment.
Fever above 38 degrees C, and pain in the side or back (flank pain).
Burning when passing urine, frequent urination, and nausea or vomiting.
Urine test and urine culture with sensitivity testing.
Kidney ultrasound or CT if you do not improve in 48 to 72 hours.
Your doctor will choose antibiotics based on the culture.
Some people need treatment into a vein in hospital.

sections.h: What you can do at home
items: Drink enough fluids unless your doctor has advised otherwise.
Finish the full course of antibiotics as prescribed.
Your doctor may repeat urine tests to confirm the infection has cleared.
This leaflet gives general information. Follow your doctor's advice.

urgent: Low blood pressure, fainting, or passing very little urine
Pain that is severe and not settling
